briefing: Markets were risk-on today with NASDAQ up 1.2% and S&P 500 up 0.7%. With $889 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into QGEN and SPCX, both showing full multi-signal bullish confirmation (RSI, MACD crossover, rising momentum, price above SMA-20), while holding our existing winners.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confluence means multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, and moving averages — all point the same direction at once. When several signals agree, it's generally considered stronger evidence of a real trend than relying on just one indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術指標共振是指多個獨立指標(如RSI、MACD及移動平均線)同時指向同一方向。當多項訊號一致時，通常被視為比單靠一個指標更可靠的趨勢證據。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, suggests continued risk appetite for growth and tech-adjacent names. Momentum names showing multiple confirming technical signals — healthy RSI, bullish MACD crossovers, and prices holding above their 20-day averages — tend to attract further buying interest in these conditions. No major single catalyst stood out; the gains appear broad-based rather than news-driven.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現強勁，納指升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映市場對科技及成長股的風險胃納持續。多隻股票同時出現技術指標共振訊號——包括RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價企穩於20日均線之上——在此市況下往往更易吸引資金追捧。今日升勢屬大市普遍性上揚,並非由單一重大消息帶動。
